messages.content: Implement the supplied original task and its implementation notes. Preserve required interfaces and non-target behavior. Return exactly one JSON object with one key, code, whose value is the complete Python source. No Markdown fences or other keys.

{"language":"python","task":"Generate python code for the following: \n  A decorator is used to bind a function to a URL.The function hello() is called when a user visits the URL /hello/<username> .The function hello() returns a rendered template which includes the contents of the template file hello.html as well as the value of the username variable.The username variable is passed to the template hello.html which displays the value of the variable."}
